hint_ladder.title: Distribute 3
hint_ladder.prompt: Expanding 3(x + 4) means multiply both terms inside the bracket by 3.

hint_ladder.prompt: The step to check is whether the outside 3 reaches both terms. It must multiply the constant as well as the x term.

hint_ladder.title: Distribution routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Multiply the outside number by each term inside the bracket, then write the two results. Use this bracket; do not copy.
